title: SQL 存储过程与触发器 (Procedure & Trigger)
description: SQL 工作流系列 (16/16)：创建、调用、删除存储过程，以及 INSERT/UPDATE 触发器的基础写法

content.tips: 建存储过程 get_orders(IN uid INT)：查 orders 中 user_id 等于 uid 的所有列
content.content: CREATE PROCEDURE get_orders(IN uid INT) BEGIN SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = uid; END;

content.tips: 建存储过程 count_orders(IN uid INT, OUT total INT)：把 orders 中 user_id 等于 uid 的行数 INTO total
content.content: CREATE PROCEDURE count_orders(IN uid INT, OUT total INT) BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO total FROM orders WHERE user_id = uid; END;

content.tips: 调用存储过程 get_orders，传参 1
删除存储过程 get_orders（存在才删）
建触发器 trg_user_log：users 插入后，往 user_logs(user_id, action) 写 NEW.id 和 created
content.content: CREATE TRIGGER trg_user_log AFTER INSERT ON users FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO user_logs(user_id, action) VALUES (NEW.id, 'created');

content.tips: 建触发器 trg_order_log：orders 更新前，往 order_logs(order_id, old_status, new_status) 写 OLD.id、OLD.status、NEW.status
content.content: CREATE TRIGGER trg_order_log BEFORE UPDATE ON orders FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO order_logs(order_id, old_status, new_status) VALUES (OLD.id, OLD.status, NEW.status);
